facts: Parties: Fenwick Marine Ltd (Buyer), Penrith Medical Ltd (Seller); the Company is Thornbury Software Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 23 February 2027; Closing is scheduled for 2 April 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 9.3 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 25% of the Purchase Price, being $57,812,500. The Purchase Price is $185,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $183,180,000.
